trainer.dialogueBefore: Jogger Scott: Rain or shine, I run every morning. And I battle whoever I pass!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Jogger Scott: Beaten and soaked. Same time tomorrow?

trainer.dialogueBefore: Jogger Craig: My Pokémon run with me every morning. Let's see if it shows!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Jogger Craig: We'll add another lap to tomorrow's run.

jogger_scott_no_battle.name: Jogger
dialog: I'm just warming down after my run. No battles now, I'm afraid.
In the morning I'll take on anyone!

jogger_craig_no_battle.name: Jogger
dialog: Splash, splash, splash... Running in the rain is harder than it looks.
If you want a battle, find me in the morning. That's when I'm at my best.

black_belt.name: Black Belt
dialog: The rain on this road never stops. Not for a single day.
I train out here anyway. If you can fight in this, you can fight anywhere!

trainer.dialogueBefore: Black Belt Derek: Rain only makes training harder, and harder is better! Battle me!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Black Belt Derek: Soaked through and beaten. At least the soaking was good training.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Black Belt Gregory: My Machop and I train as one. Let's see you handle all three of them!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Black Belt Gregory: Three of them, and not one could land the blow that mattered. Back to training!

trainer.dialogueBefore: Black Belt Nathaniel: Fists up! A real fighter never turns down a challenge!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Black Belt Nathaniel: Hmph. A hundred more push-ups in the puddles for me.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Ruin Maniac Calvin: I'm off to Celestic Town to study its ruins. You'll make a nice break on the way!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Ruin Maniac Calvin: I'll leave the battling to you and get back to my old stones.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Ace Trainer Dennis: Battling in the rain is all part of my training. Ready to get wet?
trainer.dialogueAfter: Ace Trainer Dennis: You'd do well anywhere, rain or shine.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Ace Trainer Maya: Rain is good for the flowers, and for my team too! Here we go!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Ace Trainer Maya: I'll dry off, think it over and come back stronger.

signs.trainer_tips_signpost:
Trainer Tips
In the rain, Water-type moves hit harder and Fire-type moves are weakened. Some Pokémon love a downpour!
